title: Finish working changes with an editable task
text: Seismic suggests completing unfinished repository changes and saves their complete patch separately from the task description. The description stays editable even for large captures, and the agent receives the saved changes on its own machine. Repositories with changed submodules are excluded because a parent patch cannot carry that work.
chapters: A short task, with its captured changes kept separately
Seismic proposals match in the inbox
Submodule work is not offered as a complete capture
